_comment: Layout for 'MENU DIGESTIFS' -- the original InDesign file is a single sheet with two side-by-side columns (Douceurs/Amers on the left, Digestifs on the right). This engine renders one column per page instead of side-by-side, so the two sections became two consecutive single-column pages here -- same content, same order, just stacked instead of side-by-side. Each logical page shrinks its text/spacing to stay on one printed page instead of spilling onto an extra one, same as the Wine List.
